South Indian Restaurant

Sagar Ratna

★★★★★4.12849 reviews

Sagar Ratna is a South Indian restaurant in Malviya Nagar serving dosas, idli, thalis, filter coffee, and other vegetarian specialties. Customers often recommend the Mysore masala dosa, ghee roast dosa, and thali, while appreciating the clean, family-friendly ambience and generally prompt service, though reviews on pricing and consistency are mixed.
